search.label: Search for a Riot account
search.helper: Three characters are enough. Suggestions come from accounts the site already knows: the Riot API cannot search by partial name.
search.noSuggestionDescription: That is expected while few games have been collected. Type the full Riot ID, then ask Riot: the account will join the list.

verify.helper: Account not in the list? Type the full Riot ID and ask Riot. This links nothing: the account joins the list, and clicking is what picks it.
verify.needsFullId: To ask Riot, type the full Riot ID: a single #, with text on both sides.
verify.done: {{riotId}} confirmed by Riot. Pick it from the list.
verify.unavailable: Verification with Riot is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

errors.notFound: Riot does not know that Riot ID.

ingest.title: Riot collection
ingest.subtitle: What the Riot connector collects, how fast, and how much it weighs.
ingest.loadFailed: Could not read the collection state
ingest.unavailable: The Riot connector does not answer: the collection state is unknown.

queue.title: Collection queue
queue.description: All requests together: players, team games and background collection.

crawler.title: Background collection
crawler.description: It collects the recent history of accounts met in our games, a few players from each tier every round, so a new player finds their games already there. Player requests always come first.
crawler.toggleHelper: Setting for this environment only. In production it runs permanently.
crawler.storageAlert: The database passed the {{threshold}} threshold: background collection is suspended.
crawler.storageHint: Past the threshold, background collection suspends itself.

pause.title: Ingest pause
pause.description: Stops the whole collection queue, player requests included, in production as well as here. Running tasks finish; the others wait for the resume. Use it for the duration of a database maintenance.
pause.toggleHelper: The pause survives a connector restart: remember to resume the ingest afterwards.
pause.draining_one: Paused: {{count}} task is finishing its work.
pause.draining_other: Paused: {{count}} tasks are finishing their work.
pause.stopped: Paused since {{since}}: no task running anymore.
pause.failed: The pause could not be changed.

summary.title: What the collection produced
summary.description: Games and profiles, not tasks: one game produces up to four tasks.
summary.retrievedHint: Stored in the database: a game’s detail, a profile’s history read at least once.
summary.analysedHint: Ready for computations: no timeline nor rank left to fetch for the game, nothing queued for the profile.
summary.pendingHint: In the collection queue, not retrieved yet.

debug.title: Computation debugging
debug.empty: Computation traces will show up here as analyses arrive.

window.title: Collection window
window.description: What a player's first collection fetches from Riot. Later collections only ask for what came after. Changing the window drops the background games already queued and collects their players again.
window.minGamesHelper: For a player who rarely plays: their latest games, even beyond the maximum age.
window.saved: Window saved: the collection queue now follows it.
window.saveFailed: The window could not be saved.

invalidate.title: Invalidate Riot data
invalidate.description: After a Riot key change, every player identifier changes and the collected data becomes unusable. Invalidation erases it and keeps everything else; linked accounts and team slots are found again by their Riot ID.
invalidate.needsPause: Pause the ingest first, and wait for running tasks to finish.
invalidate.dialogDescription: The erasure is final. Games within the history window will be collected again when the ingest resumes.
invalidate.goesRiot: {{value}} documents collected from Riot (games, timelines, ranks, masteries, known accounts, references, collection queue)
invalidate.staysAccounts: {{value}} linked accounts, resolved again by their Riot ID
invalidate.staysSlots: {{value}} team slots, resolved again by their Riot ID
invalidate.staysTeams: {{value}} teams, with their compositions and pools
invalidate.staysReviews: {{value}} game reviews, which will come back with their game
invalidate.done: {{riot}} Riot documents and {{findings}} findings erased. {{accounts}} accounts are being resolved; resume the ingest to restart collection.

premadelab.title: PremadeLab
premadelab.subtitle: Settings of the LoL application, managed from Schub.

budget.title: Player lookup
budget.description: A visitor gets this many unknown players collected quickly per window; beyond that, their games trickle in, with no refusal message. Counted per account, or per IP address without an account.

augur.title: Findings engine rules
augur.description: Each rule reads signals (value or tier percentile) and produces a finding with its evidence. An active version never changes: write a draft, measure what it would change, then activate it. Every action carries a comment.
augur.label: Rule
augur.contentHelp: Conditions as ramps: from "from" (degree 0) to "to" (degree 1). unit: VALUE or PERCENTILE. A "pattern:key" signal reads another rule’s degree. Sentence: {signal.value}, {signal.percentile}, {position}, {tier}.
augur.commentHelp: Why this version: required to save, activate or roll back.
augur.invalidJson: The content is not valid JSON.
augur.measured: Impact measured on a sample of already evaluated subjects.
augur.activated: Version active: its findings are recomputed in the background.
augur.rollback: Roll back to the previous version

trace.title: Engine trace
trace.description: Every active rule evaluated on a player (their habits) or one of their games, emitted or not: what you need to tune thresholds.
